353 likes, 7 comments - roobinamongia on September 30, 2026: "Apple Pay is finally here in India 🇮🇳

Apple Pay is now available on supported Apple devices, bringing contactless payments to iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.

Eligible Axis Bank credit card users can add their cards to Apple Wallet and start using Apple Pay wherever contactless payments are accepted.

Swipe through to see supported devices, cards, setup steps and how it works.

Would you use Apple Pay instead of carrying your physical card? 👀

#ApplePay #AppleIndia #iPhoneonly #Technews #trendingnow".
